issues.display_title: Issue #4367: feat: Support AI Chat Analytics - Core Layout, Route Guard, Date Picker & KPI Cards
issues.main_description_html:
Demo by Developer

Description

Build the foundation and primary overview metrics of the AI Chat Analytics page in GoThru Dashboard, specifically reserved for Support accounts to monitor AI Chat health and engagement at a glance.

Requirements & Scope

  • Route & Access Control:
    • Register route /support/ai-chat-analytics in src/routes/support.js.
    • Ensure access is strictly limited to authorized Support and Admin roles.
    • Add navigation item under the Support sidebar/menu.
  • Page Header & Date Range Filter:
    • Page title: "AI Chat Analytics" with supporting subtitle.
    • Date preset selector: Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days (default), Last 90 Days, and Custom Range.
    • Propagate date filter state globally across all sections on the page.
  • 6 KPI Overview Cards:
    • Render 6 summary metric cards:
      1. Total Questions
      2. Total Sessions
      3. Unique Questions
      4. Actions Displayed
      5. Actions Clicked
      6. Action Success Rate (%)
  • UX & State Management:
    • Implement skeleton loading state during data fetching.
    • Implement defensive error banner / toast on network failures.
    • Format large numbers and percentage values clearly and consistently.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Route /support/ai-chat-analytics is protected and accessible to Support roles.
  • Date filter options trigger data refetch with corresponding date parameters.
  • All 6 KPI cards accurately render values and percentages.
  • Responsive design across desktop screen resolutions.

issues.display_title: Issue #4368: feat: Support AI Chat Analytics - Charts, Popular Questions Table & Action Performance
issues.main_description_html:
Demo by Developer

Description

Implement the visual analytics charts and detailed data tables for the AI Chat Analytics page, enabling Support users to inspect recurring questions, action execution rates, feature categories, and intent distribution without reading individual transcripts.

Requirements & Scope

  • AI Chat Usage Trend (Line Chart):
    • Line chart illustrating daily volume over time.
    • Metrics: Questions, Sessions, Actions Displayed, Actions Clicked.
    • Allow toggling individual metric visibility.
    • Empty state: "No AI Chat activity during this period."
  • Popular Questions (Data Grid Table):
    • Columns: Rank, Question, Feature, Asked, Last Asked.
    • Default sort: Asked (Highest to Lowest).
    • Include pagination controls for scanning larger datasets.
    • Empty state: "No questions found for this period."
  • Action Performance (Chart & Table):
    • Horizontal bar chart of top clicked actions.
    • Detailed table with columns: Rank, Action, Displayed, Clicked, Success, Failed, Not Clicked, Click Rate (%), Success Rate (%).
    • Default sort: most displayed actions.
    • Visual indicators for success vs failed outcomes.
    • Empty state: "No AI actions were used during this period."
  • Feature Distribution (Horizontal Bar Chart):
    • Horizontal bar chart ordered by question volume (highest to lowest).
    • Includes General category for unmapped features.
    • Displays count and percentage.
  • Intent Distribution (Donut Chart):
    • Donut chart with standard categories: How To, Troubleshooting, Execute Action, Greeting, Other.
    • Tooltip / legend showing count and percentage.
  • UX & Visual Polish:
    • Standardized color palette for charts.
    • Empty state messages aligned with PRD specifications.
    • Clear tooltips on hover for exact numbers.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Usage trend chart plots all 4 metrics accurately by date.
  • Popular questions table displays representative question text and handles pagination cleanly.
  • Action performance table shows exact counts and derived rates without NaN or undefined errors.
  • Feature distribution and Intent distribution reflect aggregated question data.
  • Empty states appear whenever the selected time range has zero data.

issues.display_title: Issue #4381: feat(chat-ai): Ask AI right sidebar layout and RAG copilot integration
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Migrate the Ask AI chat copilot system into a dedicated right-side sidebar within the GoThru Dashboard layout, replacing the legacy tooltip/floating modal experience.

Epic Reference

  • Epic: #4377 ([PRD] GoThru Dashboard Ask AI Sidebar Chat)

Scope of Work

  • Sidebar Shell & Layout:
    • Implement ChatAiSidebar container with desktop push layout (400px width shifting main dashboard view) and mobile fullscreen modal.
    • Mount sidebar inside src/components/layouts/Layout.jsx with transition styling in src/index.scss.
  • Trigger & Toggle Control:
    • Floating Ask AI toggle button positioned above Chatwoot bubble widget.
    • Automatically hide the floating toggle when sidebar is open, and restore when closed.
    • Close button (x) inside the sidebar header.
  • Copilot RAG Integration:
    • Integrate /copilot/chat API service, service health check (/health), and session persistence in sessionStorage.
    • Sync empty state layout and Suggested Questions identical to reference system.
    • Support aborting in-flight responses via AbortController.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Clicking "Ask AI" opens the sidebar from the right.
  • Desktop main content shifts by 400px; mobile displays fullscreen without backdrop blocking.
  • Floating "Ask AI" button hides when sidebar is active and reappears upon close.
  • Chat conversation history persists when sidebar is closed and reopened.
  • Suggested Questions immediately populate and send prompt when clicked.
  • Unit tests for Layout integration and Sidebar shell pass (Layout.chatAi.test.jsx, ChatAiSidebar.test.jsx).

issues.display_title: Issue #4382: feat(chat-ai): tour @mention autocomplete search and chip tags
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Implement contextual @mention tour autocomplete and chip tag selection in the Ask AI input, enabling users to bind specific virtual tours to their queries.

Epic Reference

  • Epic: #4377 ([PRD] GoThru Dashboard Ask AI Sidebar Chat)

Scope of Work

  • Instruction Section:
    • Display a dedicated @ Type @ to mention a tour hint section above the textarea input.
  • Search Service:
    • Implement tourMentionService fetching user virtual tours from /v1/tours/list decoupled from global Redux state.
  • Autocomplete Dropdown:
    • Suggestion dropdown opening when @ is typed after start/whitespace.
    • Keyboard navigation support (ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, Tab, Escape) with auto-scroll and visual selection highlight.
  • Chip Tags Management:
    • Convert selected tour into an interactive chip tag with tour name and remove button (x).
    • Automatically clear the @<query> token from textarea once a chip is selected.
    • Pass selected tour metadata via context.mentioned_tours payload to the copilot backend.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Typing @ opens the tour suggestions dropdown with debounced search.
  • Dropdown supports full keyboard navigation (ArrowUp/ArrowDown and selection via Enter/Tab).
  • Selected tour appears as a chip above textarea, and @query is removed from input.
  • Selected chips remain preserved while typing subsequent message text.
  • Clicking (x) on a chip removes it from selected tours.
  • Outgoing chat payload includes context.mentioned_tours array.
  • Unit tests pass (useTourMention.test.js, TourMentionDropdown.test.jsx, ChatInput.test.jsx).

Demo by Developer
